notes.whatTheseAre: Plain adidas and Nike training wear with NO club crest - the range the client's 09:11 text 'Tracksuits :' was introducing. Held on 6 Sep pending a price; the 7 Sep price list settles it: plain half zip R700, plain full zip R850, sizes S-2XL.
notes.pricingIsNotTheClubTier: A club half-zip is R850 and a club full-zip R1000. These are R150 cheaper in both cuts because they carry no badge. Do not let a later batch collapse the two.
notes.duplicatePhoto: p32 and p33 are the same file at dHash distance 0, so eighteen photographs make seventeen garments.
notes.hoodedWindbreaker: p26 is a hooded WINDBREAKER set. The client's list prices a full windbreaker tracksuit at R1200, but that line sits in the club section; the plain range only gives half zip and full zip. It is listed at the plain full-zip R850 - FLAG FOR CLIENT.
